proof_scope: Tau accepted turn/tool/join episode projection through the existing Memory outbox and governed Memory /store API

claims.proves: Tau builds redacted memory.tau_orchestration_episode.v1 payloads from accepted journal facts, enqueues them in the existing outbox, relays them through governed Memory /store, reads them back by key and recall, replay-dedupes projected rows, degrades on Memory outage without changing settlement, permanently records schema rejection without changing settlement, and rejects forbidden raw text plus lineage mutation.
claims.does_not_prove: Full graph traversal UX, multimodal indexing of real image/audio artifacts, provider semantic quality, GOAL.md completion, or human acceptance.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Accepted Tau turn/tool/join/settlement facts are normalized into governed Memory orchestration episode payloads, projected via the existing outbox, replay-deduped, redacted, and resilient to Memory outage or schema rejection.
